title: Europan Location Level and Encounter Registry
description: A ten-level radial taxonomy shared by NPC stations, player stations, world locations, route destinations, and encounter generation. Level 1 begins at the outermost ring; Level 10 is the unique Eye of Europa at ring zero.

gradient.formula: ring 0 => 10; otherwise 1 + floor((rings - ring) * 9 / rings), clamped to 1..9

levels.name: The Frontier
levels.subtitle: Basic Settlements
levels.summary: The shallowest habitations, transit remnants, prospecting camps, and early colonies where pressure is manageable and imported supplies remain common.
levels.availability: Common civilian goods, basic medicine, common tools, light weapons, food, oxygen, and low-tier repairs.

levels.name: Logistics & Resource Extraction
levels.subtitle: Developing Zones
levels.summary: Construction, mining, farming, and fabrication zones that feed the deeper settlements with food, metal, fuel, pressure components, and replacement machinery.
levels.availability: Industrial tools, mining equipment, bulk materials, reactor fuel, hydroponic produce, and standard fabrication services.

levels.name: Established Hubs
levels.subtitle: Advanced Infrastructure
levels.summary: Large population centers with reliable medicine, shipbuilding, research, administration, and dense commercial districts.
levels.availability: Broad civilian catalogue, advanced medicine, specialist equipment, ship upgrades, research services, and high-capacity repair.

levels.name: The Vanguard
levels.subtitle: Militarized Zones
levels.summary: Fortified installations and fleet concentrations guarding human territory against fauna, pirates, cults, and rival governments.
levels.availability: Military weapons, ammunition, armor, security equipment, restricted components, escorts, and fortified drydock services.

levels.name: The Descent
levels.subtitle: Hostile & Contested Territory
levels.summary: The boundary where orderly control breaks down into active attacks, abandoned infrastructure, pirate rule, and unstable natural passages.
levels.availability: Unreliable markets, salvage brokers, black-market medicine, contraband weapons, emergency repairs, and limited food or oxygen.

levels.name: The Forgotten Deep
levels.subtitle: Derelict Infrastructure
levels.summary: Flooded and crushed remains of failed expansion programmes. These locations are dead infrastructure rather than functioning communities.
levels.availability: No stable shops. Salvage, sealed lockers, damaged fabricators, reactor components, and contaminated emergency stores may be recovered.

levels.name: The Abyss
levels.subtitle: Alien & Infected Grounds
levels.summary: Fauna-dominated depths, Husk territories, ancient feeding grounds, and biological regions where humanity is no longer the principal inhabitant.
levels.availability: No lawful trade. Biological samples, cult stores, lost expedition equipment, alien materials, and dangerous salvage may exist.

levels.name: The Thermal Vents
levels.subtitle: Extreme Environments
levels.summary: Boiling, toxic, mechanically violent regions surrounding geothermal fractures and industrial taps into Europa’s deeper heat.
levels.availability: Specialized heat shielding, pressure armor, coolant, industrial explosives, geothermal equipment, and rare mineral extraction services.

levels.name: The Precursor Ruins
levels.subtitle: Alien Artifacts & Dead Zones
levels.summary: Impossible structures and enormous dead sectors where geometry, acoustics, gravity, and human perception cease behaving reliably.
levels.availability: No conventional commerce. Alien artifacts, precursor machinery, research data, and unrecoverable losses dominate expedition economics.

levels.name: The Core
levels.subtitle: Singularity
levels.summary: The unique center of the campaign world: the Eye of Europa, an anomaly with no equivalent elsewhere on the map.
levels.availability: Unknown. No ordinary market, settlement service, or reliable resupply exists.

locations.name: Abandoned Surface Tunnel Connection
locations.availability: Old surface equipment, frozen freight, damaged pressure doors.
locations.lore: A once-vital connection to a surface installation, sealed after ice movement crushed its upper galleries. Prospectors revisit these tunnels for old cargo and forgotten personnel records.
locations.encounter: Restore the tunnel controls long enough to recover a sealed manifest before the ice shifts again.
locations.reward: Surface charts, old cargo, and a safe emergency route.
locations.failure: Collapse, trapped personnel, and loss of oxygen.

locations.name: Camp
locations.availability: Food, water, oxygen, common tools, batteries, and improvised medicine.
locations.lore: A temporary cluster of pressure shelters built around a survey claim, mining face, or emergency beacon. Camps often become permanent despite never being designed to survive a decade.
locations.encounter: Negotiate for scarce fuel while the camp’s failing generator forces a ration dispute.
locations.reward: Cheap provisions and local route intelligence.
locations.failure: Hostile locals, inflated prices, and delayed departure.

locations.name: Barren Ice Field
locations.availability: No market; occasional abandoned probes and mineral samples.
locations.lore: A wide plain of pale ice with few landmarks and little life. Its apparent emptiness makes it useful for surveys, clandestine transfers, and ambushes.
locations.encounter: Cross the field using unreliable survey beacons while something follows beneath the ice.
locations.reward: A shortened route and intact survey instruments.
locations.failure: Navigation loss, collision damage, or an ambush.

locations.name: Outpost
locations.availability: Common equipment, basic medical supplies, ammunition, food, and standard tools.
locations.lore: A modest permanent port serving local traffic. Outposts are the ordinary connective tissue of Europan settlement, rarely prosperous but usually indispensable.
locations.encounter: A delayed supply convoy has left the outpost choosing which docked vessel receives the last oxygen reserve.
locations.reward: Priority service and station reputation.
locations.failure: Supply rationing and local hostility.

locations.name: Survey Location
locations.availability: Survey probes, mapping data, sample containers, and temporary shelters.
locations.lore: A marked site where geologists, navigators, or biologists have installed temporary instruments. Some remain active; others continue transmitting long after their crews vanished.
locations.encounter: Recover a survey recorder from terrain that has changed since the original map was made.
locations.reward: Accurate charts, research data, and mineral claims.
locations.failure: Lost equipment and a newly revealed hazard.

locations.name: Settlement
locations.availability: Broad common goods with limited specialist stock.
locations.lore: A civilian community large enough to possess permanent families, workshops, and political arguments. Settlements depend heavily on regular submarine traffic.
locations.encounter: Mediate a labor dispute before dockworkers refuse to unload the crew’s cargo.
locations.reward: Union goodwill, discounted services, and local contacts.
locations.failure: Cargo delay and faction reputation loss.

locations.name: Mine
locations.availability: Basic mining tools, explosives, metals, fuel, and work clothing.
locations.lore: A shallow extraction station working accessible ice and mineral seams. Its profits are modest, its equipment overused, and its crews perpetually promised improvements next quarter.
locations.encounter: Stabilize a collapsing extraction gallery while trapped miners argue over whether the company will pay rescue costs.
locations.reward: Ore, explosives, and strong labor reputation.
locations.failure: Casualties, blocked production, and corporate hostility.

locations.name: Colony
locations.availability: Reliable common supplies and occasional advanced imports.
locations.lore: A recognized permanent colony with multiple residential sections, civic institutions, and a growing sense that distant authorities do not understand local conditions.
locations.encounter: A population surge forces the colony to requisition cargo space from visiting submarines.
locations.reward: Colonial contracts and long-term reputation.
locations.failure: Legal penalties or an angry displaced population.

locations.name: Deep Colony Slum
locations.availability: Used tools, improvised weapons, stolen medicine, cheap food, and counterfeit components.
locations.lore: An overcrowded lower district attached to a larger colony, built from maintenance corridors and obsolete pressure compartments. It is ignored until authorities need labor, votes, or someone to blame.
locations.encounter: Find a missing worker before a cartel recruiter or security patrol reaches them first.
locations.reward: Informants, contraband access, and community loyalty.
locations.failure: Extortion, arrest, or faction retaliation.

locations.name: Construction Site
locations.availability: Structural materials, welding fuel, pumps, wiring, and construction machinery.
locations.lore: A half-completed installation surrounded by work barges and exposed structural frames. Construction schedules are political documents disguised as engineering plans.
locations.encounter: Prevent a pressure-frame failure without shutting down the project’s only profitable construction bay.
locations.reward: Discounted structural components and contractor support.
locations.failure: Hull damage, casualties, and contract penalties.

locations.name: Mine
locations.availability: Advanced mining gear, bulk metals, explosives, pressure suits, and reactor fuel.
locations.lore: A mature extraction complex whose shafts extend far beyond the inhabited pressure hull. Production quotas here can determine whether entire regions receive replacement parts.
locations.encounter: A strike and a tunnel emergency occur simultaneously, forcing the crew to choose who controls the rescue operation.
locations.reward: Large mineral cargo and faction leverage.
locations.failure: Production shutdown, casualties, and political escalation.

locations.name: Hydroponics
locations.availability: Fresh food, water, medicines, seeds, fertilizer, and biological samples.
locations.lore: A warm agricultural station whose green chambers are among the rare places on Europa where civilians see living plants. A failed crop can become a regional famine.
locations.encounter: Diagnose a spreading blight before quarantine authorities destroy the entire harvest.
locations.reward: Food stores, medical plants, and agricultural contracts.
locations.failure: Crop loss, contamination, and food shortages.

locations.name: Factory
locations.availability: Components, tools, ammunition, machinery, pressure parts, and manufactured goods.
locations.lore: A production station where ore becomes the pumps, shells, batteries, and junction boxes keeping Europa alive. Every faction wants its output and none want to pay the workers more.
locations.encounter: Trace defective components before an entire production batch reaches frontline submarines.
locations.reward: Components, fabrication priority, and industrial reputation.
locations.failure: Widespread equipment failures and liability claims.

locations.name: Clinic
locations.availability: Advanced medicines, blood, antidotes, surgical tools, and medical consultations.
locations.lore: A specialist medical station serving several surrounding colonies. Clinics are cleaner than most ports and far more politically connected than their size suggests.
locations.encounter: A contaminated patient arrives while a pharmaceutical shipment disappears from secure storage.
locations.reward: Advanced treatment and medical reputation.
locations.failure: Outbreak, missing drugs, and quarantine delay.

locations.name: Hospital
locations.availability: Highest ordinary medical availability outside dedicated research sites.
locations.lore: A regional hospital with pressure wards, surgical theaters, and morgues large enough to reveal what local authorities expect from the future.
locations.encounter: A mass-casualty convoy overwhelms the hospital while officials attempt to reserve beds for politically valuable patients.
locations.reward: Full recovery, rare medicine, and humanitarian standing.
locations.failure: Preventable deaths and regional outrage.

locations.name: Research Institute
locations.availability: Advanced instruments, rare chemicals, prototypes, and licensed research services.
locations.lore: A large scientific institution with competing departments, private sponsors, and security rules written after incidents no one will describe.
locations.encounter: Secure a laboratory after a prototype begins producing impossible sensor readings.
locations.reward: Research data, prototype access, and scientific contacts.
locations.failure: Containment loss, stolen research, or mental trauma.

locations.name: Shipyard
locations.availability: Broad submarine systems, heavy weapons, structural upgrades, and specialist crews.
locations.lore: A massive dock complex capable of rebuilding submarines rather than merely patching them. Shipyards are strategic assets and frequent targets of sabotage.
locations.encounter: Protect a vessel under construction when competing clients claim ownership of its reactor and weapons.
locations.reward: Major repair, upgrade access, and shipyard favor.
locations.failure: Seized equipment, dock damage, and legal conflict.

locations.name: City
locations.availability: Nearly all lawful civilian goods and many restricted items through permits or influence.
locations.lore: A dense urban pressure complex containing neighborhoods, transit tubes, industry, hospitals, government offices, and enough people to produce every human problem at once.
locations.encounter: A citywide systems failure triggers unrest while several factions compete to control emergency distribution.
locations.reward: Extensive trade, political access, and major contracts.
locations.failure: Riots, shortages, and broad faction consequences.

locations.name: Base
locations.availability: Military weapons, ammunition, armor, sonar equipment, and controlled medical supplies.
locations.lore: A fortified garrison supporting patrol submarines and regional security operations. Every visitor is logged, searched, and evaluated as either an asset or a threat.
locations.encounter: Clear the crew’s vessel after security finds contraband planted aboard during docking.
locations.reward: Military contracts, escorts, and armory access.
locations.failure: Detention, confiscation, and faction hostility.

locations.name: Blockade
locations.availability: Ammunition, fuel, military rations, and emergency repairs only.
locations.lore: A chain of armed platforms, patrol submarines, mines, and inspection docks controlling movement through a strategic passage.
locations.encounter: Pass the blockade while rival commanders issue contradictory orders and weapons remain trained on the submarine.
locations.reward: Safe passage and military intelligence.
locations.failure: Boarding, seizure, or armed engagement.

locations.name: Fortress
locations.availability: Heavy submarine ammunition, advanced armor, restricted systems, and military-grade medicine.
locations.lore: A deep armored installation designed to remain functional during prolonged assault. Its guns control entire route networks and its command staff know it.
locations.encounter: Defend or escape the fortress during a coordinated internal and external attack.
locations.reward: Heavy equipment, strategic alliance, and safe regional passage.
locations.failure: Capture, massive damage, or regional military collapse.

locations.name: Military Forces
locations.availability: Dependent on faction standing; may provide ammunition, intelligence, or arrest warrants.
locations.lore: A mobile fleet element, patrol group, or militia concentration operating without a permanent station.
locations.encounter: Identify the fleet’s allegiance and intentions before entering weapons range.
locations.reward: Escort, intelligence, or emergency resupply.
locations.failure: Forced inspection, requisition, or battle.

locations.name: Natural Formation
locations.availability: No trade; mineral deposits and biological samples may be present.
locations.lore: A vast cavern, ice arch, stone forest, or mineral reef large enough to alter navigation and shelter unknown life.
locations.encounter: Navigate the formation while deciding whether its sheltered interior is refuge or a feeding trap.
locations.reward: Rare minerals and a concealed route.
locations.failure: Collision, entrapment, or creature attack.

locations.name: Under Attack
locations.availability: Only emergency supplies remain available, often requisitioned or rationed.
locations.lore: Any inhabited location caught during an active assault. Its normal identity matters less than which compartments still have pressure.
locations.encounter: Choose between defending the docks, evacuating civilians, and preserving the station reactor.
locations.reward: Rescue reputation, salvage rights, and grateful survivors.
locations.failure: Station loss, casualties, and hostile control.

locations.name: Abandoned Outpost
locations.availability: Damaged equipment, sealed storage, old records, and unknown contaminants.
locations.lore: A recently abandoned station whose machinery has not yet fully died. The reason for evacuation is often more valuable—and more dangerous—than its remaining equipment.
locations.encounter: Restore partial power and determine why the evacuation alarm was never cancelled.
locations.reward: Salvage, records, and a defensible temporary base.
locations.failure: Trapped crew, infection, or catastrophic decompression.

locations.name: Pirate Haven
locations.availability: Contraband weapons, stolen medicine, illegal upgrades, ammunition, and uncertain-quality components.
locations.lore: A fortified criminal port protected by hidden approaches, bribed officials, and enough guns to make law enforcement reconsider its priorities.
locations.encounter: Complete a transaction while two criminal organizations dispute who has authority to tax it.
locations.reward: Black-market access, smuggling routes, and rare equipment.
locations.failure: Robbery, debt, betrayal, or a bounty.

locations.name: Submerged Vault
locations.availability: Preserved archives, valuables, munitions, or nothing but water behind armored doors.
locations.lore: An armored storage or continuity bunker now completely flooded. Its builders expected disaster but not necessarily the one that arrived.
locations.encounter: Open the vault without equalizing pressure through the crew compartment.
locations.reward: High-value sealed cargo and historical records.
locations.failure: Violent decompression and destroyed contents.

locations.name: Flooded Reactor
locations.availability: Fuel rods, control components, shielding, and irradiated machinery.
locations.lore: The power heart of a dead installation, flooded while still hot. Its surviving components are extraordinarily valuable and frequently lethal.
locations.encounter: Extract intact reactor controls while intermittent current energizes the flooded chamber.
locations.reward: Rare reactor components and fuel.
locations.failure: Radiation exposure, electrocution, or reactor collapse.

locations.name: Crushed Bio-Dome
locations.availability: Preserved seeds, medical cultures, biomass, and contaminated growth systems.
locations.lore: A failed agricultural or ecological habitat crushed into a tangled chamber of metal, glass, and escaped life-support organisms.
locations.encounter: Recover a viable seed archive while unknown growth blocks the return route.
locations.reward: Rare biological stock and medical cultures.
locations.failure: Contamination, entrapment, and lost samples.

locations.name: Feeding Grounds
locations.availability: Biological samples and remains of previous prey.
locations.lore: A region where large predators repeatedly gather around migration routes, geothermal warmth, or accumulated wreckage.
locations.encounter: Cross without triggering a feeding response from creatures already circling another carcass.
locations.reward: Rare biological samples and salvage from prior victims.
locations.failure: Coordinated creature attack and severe hull damage.

locations.name: Breeding Grounds / Lair
locations.availability: Eggs, rare tissues, and lost expedition equipment.
locations.lore: A nest complex whose inhabitants defend it with greater coordination and violence than ordinary hunting behavior suggests.
locations.encounter: Retrieve an expedition beacon without disturbing the breeding chambers.
locations.reward: Rare specimens and expedition data.
locations.failure: Swarm response and blocked retreat.

locations.name: Swarm of Husk Infected
locations.availability: Infected equipment, cult tokens, and medical evidence.
locations.lore: A mobile concentration of infected humans and creatures, often following a signal, current, or command no uninfected observer can detect.
locations.encounter: Break through the swarm without allowing infected boarders into the submarine.
locations.reward: Recovered evidence and cleared passage.
locations.failure: Boarding casualties and Husk exposure.

locations.name: Husked Grounds
locations.availability: Contaminated salvage and biological samples.
locations.lore: A former human worksite or habitat transformed into an infection ecology. Familiar machinery remains, but its operators no longer use it for human purposes.
locations.encounter: Recover station records while determining which apparently dead bodies are waiting.
locations.reward: Infection research and valuable abandoned systems.
locations.failure: Husk outbreak and quarantine.

locations.name: Church of Husk
locations.availability: Husk eggs, stolen medicine, diving equipment, biological samples, and cult-manufactured supplies.
locations.lore: A concealed or openly claimed sanctuary where Husk cultists interpret infection as communion, transformation, or escape from pressure-bound humanity.
locations.encounter: Enter under false pretenses to rescue a captive before the congregation begins its rite.
locations.reward: Cult intelligence, biological evidence, and rescued prisoners.
locations.failure: Exposure, capture, or forced infection.

locations.name: Bioluminescent Trench
locations.availability: Rare luminescent organisms and chemical compounds.
locations.lore: A trench illuminated by vast colonies of organisms whose coordinated light patterns may be communication, camouflage, or bait.
locations.encounter: Follow a safe light pattern while avoiding the signals that attract larger creatures.
locations.reward: Rare compounds and a mapped deep route.
locations.failure: Sensor blindness and predator attack.

locations.name: Leviathan Graveyard
locations.availability: Massive bones, embedded artifacts, swallowed wreckage, and rare tissues.
locations.lore: An accumulation of colossal remains whose scale makes submarines resemble insects between ribs. Some corpses are ancient. Others are recent enough to still move.
locations.encounter: Recover a wreck lodged inside a leviathan skeleton before scavengers collapse it.
locations.reward: Exceptional salvage and biological material.
locations.failure: Entrapment, swarm attack, or awakening movement.

locations.name: Geothermal Extractor
locations.availability: Coolant, heat shielding, industrial pumps, reactor equipment, and rare minerals.
locations.lore: A heavily armored station harvesting heat and mineral-rich fluids from deep fractures. Its power output is immense and its maintenance margin microscopic.
locations.encounter: Stabilize an extractor during a thermal surge before operators abandon the station.
locations.reward: Power cells, coolant, and geothermal contracts.
locations.failure: Station breach and superheated flooding.

locations.name: Magma Tap Station
locations.availability: Top-tier industrial materials, thermal systems, explosives, and pressure-rated components.
locations.lore: An extreme industrial installation tapping material closer to Europa’s interior than ordinary engineering doctrine permits.
locations.encounter: Repair the tap controls while management suppresses evidence that the fracture is widening.
locations.reward: Rare alloys and advanced industrial access.
locations.failure: Catastrophic thermal release and regional route closure.

locations.name: Boiling Caverns
locations.availability: Rare minerals and heat-resistant organisms.
locations.lore: A cavern network filled with violently circulating superheated water and steam-like pressure phenomena.
locations.encounter: Time the passage between thermal pulses while navigation instruments drift.
locations.reward: Rare mineral deposits and a deep shortcut.
locations.failure: Thermal hull damage and disabled sensors.

locations.name: Superheated Fissure
locations.availability: High-value ores and geothermal samples.
locations.lore: A narrow fracture periodically ejecting heat, minerals, and shattered rock with enough force to move a submarine.
locations.encounter: Harvest a rare deposit between unpredictable venting cycles.
locations.reward: Exceptional ore and research samples.
locations.failure: Severe hull damage and lost equipment.

locations.name: Toxic Sulfur Vent
locations.availability: Sulfur compounds, industrial chemicals, and extremophile samples.
locations.lore: A mineral chimney field emitting corrosive compounds that attack metal, seals, lungs, and unprotected electronics.
locations.encounter: Recover chemical samples after corrosive deposits disable an external team’s equipment.
locations.reward: Rare chemicals and antidote research.
locations.failure: Corrosion, poisoning, and abandoned divers.

locations.name: Alien Monolith
locations.availability: Alien materials, inscriptions, energy readings, and dangerous artifacts.
locations.lore: A singular structure rising from the seabed without seams, corrosion, or an obvious purpose. Instruments disagree about its size.
locations.encounter: Interpret the monolith’s activation sequence before another expedition triggers it blindly.
locations.reward: Alien data and a controlled artifact.
locations.failure: Guardian attack, mental trauma, or permanent anomaly.

locations.name: Resonance Chamber
locations.availability: Alien resonators, acoustic data, and precursor components.
locations.lore: An alien chamber that responds to sound, sonar, heartbeat, and machinery vibration. Correct tones open paths; incorrect ones alter the surrounding structure.
locations.encounter: Match the chamber’s frequency without resonating the submarine hull apart.
locations.reward: Precursor components and route access.
locations.failure: System damage, hearing injury, and sealed escape paths.

locations.name: Fractal Maze
locations.availability: Artifacts, impossible maps, and lost expedition caches.
locations.lore: A ruin whose corridors repeat at different scales and return explorers to places they never visited.
locations.encounter: Maintain a shared route record while the maze changes scale around the team.
locations.reward: Rare artifacts and a precursor navigation model.
locations.failure: Separated crew, lost time, and sanity damage.

locations.name: Pitch-Black Void
locations.availability: Unknown; conventional sensors reveal almost nothing.
locations.lore: A region where natural and artificial light vanish almost immediately and sonar returns arrive distorted or not at all.
locations.encounter: Cross by inertial navigation while external contact noises move around the hull.
locations.reward: A hidden route and unprecedented sensor data.
locations.failure: Navigation loss, collision, and psychological trauma.

locations.name: Barren Depths
locations.availability: No known resources beyond unusual geological data.
locations.lore: An enormous region apparently lacking life, wreckage, useful minerals, or acoustic landmarks. Its emptiness becomes a logistical threat of its own.
locations.encounter: Maintain course and crew discipline during an extended crossing with no external reference points.
locations.reward: Mapped passage and proof of endurance.
locations.failure: Resource depletion, course error, and mounting sanity loss.

locations.name: Silent Expanse
locations.availability: Rare acoustic data and unidentified signals.
locations.lore: A dead zone where machinery noise seems absorbed and radio communication becomes unreliable. Crews often report hearing voices through unpowered equipment.
locations.encounter: Investigate a distress call received only after all communication equipment is shut down.
locations.reward: Unique signal data and a recovered expedition log.
locations.failure: Ambush, communication failure, and sanity damage.

locations.name: Eye of Europa
locations.availability: No known commerce or dependable resupply.
locations.lore: The unique anomaly at the exact center of the world map. Every inward route ultimately bends toward it, and every faction possesses a different explanation for why it must be reached, sealed, studied, worshipped, or destroyed.
locations.encounter: Enter the Eye of Europa and determine whether the signals guiding humanity inward are a warning, an invitation, or a mechanism.
locations.reward: The truth at the center of Europa and consequences capable of reshaping the campaign world.
locations.failure: Irreversible transformation, annihilation, or release of what the Eye contains.
